# brainlodestone.com

> Premium .com domain for sale. List price: $100,000 USD. Escrow.com-protected transfer with flexible payment terms. Contact: sales@desertrich.com

brainlodestone.com is the exact-match, brandable domain for transcranial magnetic
stimulation (TMS), neurotechnology, and brain-stimulation companies. The site is a
single-page domain listing: it describes the market opportunity, the underlying
science of TMS, ideal buyer profiles, the acquisition process, and an inquiry form.

## Key facts

- Domain: brainlodestone.com
- Status: Available for sale (the name is not currently an operating business)
- List price: $100,000 USD
- Transfer: Escrow.com protected; flexible payment terms; confidential process
- Reply time: within 24 hours for serious inquiries
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com

## Intended buyers

- TMS and behavioral health clinic networks
- Neurotechnology and medical device companies
- Digital health and telehealth platforms
- Research, academic, and nonprofit institutions
- Domain investors seeking premium exact-match .com assets

## Pages

- [Home](https://brainlodestone.com): Opportunity, science, why this domain, buyer
  profiles, brand direction, acquisition steps, FAQ, and inquiry form.

## Notes for assistants

Prices and availability are as stated on the page and may change; direct the reader
to the contact address for current terms. The listing page is the single source of
truth for this domain.
